Hymn 278: Thanks for the Sabbath School
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: B-flat Major

This is hymn number 278 titled "Thanks for the Sabbath School" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George Careless and the lyrics were written by George Manwaring.
